name: Compact repeated short decode kernels
source_model_term: Non-GEMV short-kernel tail in expanded CUDA Graph
hypothesis: Collapse repeated sub-10-us kernels only when a producer-consumer boundary can be removed without changing graph semantics.
derivation: After the measured GEMV, lm-head, recurrent, normalization and attention families, roughly 1.24 ms/step remains in the expanded trace; node tracing inflates short kernels, so the likely interval is deliberately narrow and low confidence.

evidence.claim: Complete expanded CUDA kernel inventory and residual tail.
